messages.content: "請問你能幫我找到藝術家文森·梵谷在蘇富比拍賣平台上作品名為「星夜」的價格，然後再去查詢愛德華·孟克在佳士得拍賣平台上作品名為「吶喊」的價格嗎？之後，我想在紐約公共圖書館搜尋哈波·李的作品名為「梅岡城故事」的書籍，然後在大英圖書館尋找喬治·奧威爾的作品名為「1984」的書籍。"

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple queries:

1) Find Van Gogh painting Starry Night at Sotheby's (Suprib? Actually Suprib maybe typo; but they say 蘇富比 which is Sotheby’s). So we need to fetch price via art_auction_fetch_artwork_price with artwork_name="Starry Night", artist="Vincent van Gogh", platform="Sothebys".

2) Then find Munch painting The Scream at Christie's. Use same function.

3) Next search NYPL for Hapo Li (?) They wrote 哈波·李 - likely "Habo Lee"? But anyway use library_search_book with title="梅岡城故事", author="哈波·李". Platform=NYPL or unspecified? Provide platform param as "New York Public Library".

But note library_search_book expects platform optional default all. We can specify platform if needed.

We also want British Library for Orwell 1984. Title "1984", author "George Orwell", platform "British Library".

Thus four calls: two art auctions and two libraries.

We'll call each sequentially using tool calls. We'll produce JSON output accordingly. Let's do first art auction fetch.
